entries.title: Fixed Platform Poise-Beam Parcel Scale
entries.description: One complete original fixed mechanical parcel-scale appearance: low broad platform on a ground frame, independent rear column with transverse fulcrum, unequal-arm beam, genuinely bored rectangular poise, short-arm counterweight, lower and vertical transfer links, and an open index frame. No old electronic scale, two-pan balance or crossed lift geometry imported. Raised index ticks are non-calibrated visual marks. One static model, zero scenes; no weighing, accuracy, calibration, motion, equilibrium, capacity, manufacturing, load or safety claim.
